comparison.objective: Remove spacer dowels so laminate settles and bonds accurately to a drawer front.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequentially pull full-length supports while controlling sag, tip, drag, and irreversible first contact.
comparison.success_condition: All three laminate panels bond while registered within 6 mm in x and 8 mm in y, retaining edge overhang, with grippers clear for one second.
comparison.reason: This tests controlled support removal and irreversible planar bonding, not adjustable mechanism locking or response commissioning.
